svg.text: Arduino UNO (CH340) USB-UART Bridge • 5V → 3.3V Logic Level Shifting • AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM (OV2640)
RESET connected to GND bypasses onboard MCU
Bridge for Flash, Remove to RUN
Fast: WiFi Sync | Slow: WS Sync
Protects ESP32 3.3V GPIO against 5V over-voltage damage
ESP32 3.3V HIGH is well above Uno CH340 input threshold (~2.7V)
1. Bridge Uno RESET to GND and ESP32 GPIO 0 to GND.
2. Connect USB cable, press ESP32 RST button once.
3. Run PlatformIO Upload (COM port detected by CH340).
4. When finished, REMOVE GPIO 0 jumper and press RST.
